summary: Focus Universal Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the September 8, 2026 issuance of 279,330 common shares upon exercise of outstanding warrants at $13.32 per share, generating approximately $3.7 million in gross cash proceeds. The warrants stem from an April 6, 2026 private placement; post-issuance shares outstanding total 982,012. The company intends to use proceeds for product development and working capital. No advisor, board recommendation, premium, or closing conditions are stated. As a warrant-exercise capital raise rather than a return of capital, this is a routine financing disclosure with minimal deal-risk implications.
